authority: Explicit user authorisation in the controlling RQ2b-NC task after the Phase-4 method-gate preflight.
scope_boundary: This is a prospective, outcome-blind allocation and source-path-resolution amendment. It does not change the candidate source universe, historical V3, any original source bytes, the K=6 maximum, the adequacy rubric, or any acceptable-set/retrieval/reranking outcome.

nc_legacy_two_member_checkpoint.interpretation_boundary: The additional N candidate is an outcome-blind navigation/coverage comparator, not a newly asserted third local route or a claim that the legacy cluster passed the source-native all-three-family gate.
nc_legacy_two_member_checkpoint.required_sensitivity_reporting: Report this stratum separately and preserve a sensitivity analysis excluding it from the source-native three-member NC population.

selection_invariants: Force only the frozen canonical local roster, then select external candidates from the frozen canonical union minus that roster.
Within each channel use the prospectively frozen score descending then canonical source SHA-256 ascending order.
Skip every already-selected SHA globally; no SHA may fill more than one main-pool slot.
When no positive unused candidate remains in a required channel, continue its complete eligible ranking in the same order and tag the chosen row as a zero-score coverage fallback.
Fail closed for any prompt lacking six distinct eligible main-pool candidates; never shorten the pool, alter K, use a label, or substitute a manual choice.

path_resolution_amendment.rule: When a union source has no usable direct source-path value, resolve its sole nested local_nc_origin_records[].provenance_record.source_paths entry only if the bound provenance identity equals the canonical SHA-256, the existing provenance and source-byte replay statuses are PASS, the path exists, and its observed SHA-256 equals the canonical source SHA-256.
prohibited: Do not search for alternative files or accept a path with a mismatched byte hash.
Do not use path, origin, provenance, licence, alias, target, label, retrieval output, reranking output, provider output or metric in relevance scoring.

tail_boundary: At most two deterministic, source-unique tails per predeclared prompt group remain outside the six main slots and must be frozen before any acceptable-set label is read. A fully acceptable positive tail opens the SOP method gate; it does not alter K automatically.
